notes: Wiki self-conflicts the cross-checks cannot see (AMENDMENTS-004 B19). The named field is withheld: Unknown + a source-mismatch gap, consistent with the automatic cross-check withholds (Chik, Flower of Fire, Inferno Fork, Starlight). Never pick a side on conflicting sources.

evidence quotes are checked verbatim against the cached articles; cargoTag is the conflicting Cargo Items tag — when the wiki drops it the build fails so the entry is removed instead of withholding a resolved value.

entries.detail: the Cargo Items infobox tag names the Clothier as vendor (vendor:Clothier), while the article says the Stylist sells it in a Graveyard and the 1.4.5.7 patch notes say the Stylist sells it instead of the Clothier — conflicting wiki sources, so no vendor is picked

evidence.quote: The Pretty Mirror can be purchased from the Stylist while in a Graveyard for 1 Gold.
Stylist now sells Pretty Mirrors when in the graveyard, instead of the Clothier.
